response.sql: WITH account_metrics AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, a.account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS amount_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY d.A3, a.account_id), region_metrics AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_avg) AS amount_avg, AVG(balance_avg) AS balance_avg FROM account_metrics GROUP BY region), region_mean AS (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) AS mean_amount_avg FROM region_metrics) SELECT r.region, r.amount_avg, r.balance_avg, r.amount_avg / m.mean_amount_avg AS amount_avg_ratio FROM region_metrics r CROSS JOIN region_mean m WHERE m.mean_amount_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Accounts without any transactions are excluded because account averages cannot be computed; accounts with transactions but no PRIJEM or VYDAJ transactions have a NULL amount average, which SQL AVG ignores when averaging account figures for their region.
